title: FDA Predetermined Change Control Plans for AI-Enabled Medical Devices: Manufacturer Experience: Data and analysis code
description:
Analysis code and processed data accompanying the study "FDA Predetermined Change Control Plans for AI-Enabled Medical Devices: Manufacturer Experience". Five Jupyter notebooks analyze the post-submission survey, pre-submission survey, survey coding reliability, interview domain counts and agreement, and FDA authorization census. The package includes eleven CSV inputs and instructions for reproducing twelve result tables. The software and its execution documentation are licensed under MIT; the data and data documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE for the component scopes.
